author: Randy , originally from Texas
text: We’ve used Steve’s Septic for routine septic service as well as portable rentals, and the experience has been consistently excellent. Their professionalism, responsiveness, and attention to detail really stand out. One phone call is all it takes to know the issue will be handled promptly and done right. Highly recommended.

author: Billy “Billyblues” Hill
text: Excellent Service along with a fair price. I cannot say enough about how much I appreciate these folks. Always good to use local vendors and you will not regret using Steve's for your septic needs!!

author: Mary Ellen McAllister
text: We called on a Friday morning and Steve was on our property within 2 hours. We had no idea where our septic tank was and he found it immediately. His service was prompt and dependable. And he is very honest and trustworthy. We highly recommend him! We will use him again in the future for our septic service needs! Thank you, Steve!!

author: Dustin Wells
text: Steve's is the best septic service in NWA. I called him Monday morning and despite being busy he found time to come to Huntsville on Tuesday afternoon and empty my septic tank. He and Dave were very friendly. I was not home when they arrived and they took the time to explain to my son everything they were doing. If ever I need my septic pumped again, I will be calling Steve, and you should too.
